'''July 2000 Hatfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Harrier pub, Hatfield, England on 16 July 2000. [[Nick Rice]] won it. It is known from Chris Moore's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1017">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-hatfield-uk-7-16-2000d1017/ hatfield-uk-7-16-2000], DeckTech (Chris "Lt. Cabbage" Moore, 17 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-hatfield-uk-7-16-2000d1017/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Harrier pub, Hatfield, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Nick Rice]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Chris Moore's report gives 12 players; Jamie Giberti's report gives 14 and lists 14 final standings (two players left early and were declared joint last).<ref name="tr-d1017" />
* Chris Moore's report gives 12 players; Jamie Giberti's report gives 14 and lists 14 final standings (two players left early and were declared joint last).<ref name="tr-d1022" />
